scanNote:
WORKBOOK 15-BET. Unit 3 — uy haqida so'rash, o'qish va yozish.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 12-mashq (6 savol), 13-mashq (matndan 10 qayd), 14-mashq (xatning 4 bo'shlig'i).

⚠ 12-MAShQ — JAVOB SAVOLNI AYTADI:
  'on the other side of town' → WHERE IS IT?
  'a big house, not very expensive' → WHAT'S IT LIKE?
  '£500 per month' → HOW MUCH IS IT?
  xonalar ro'yxati → HOW MANY ROOMS HAS IT GOT?
  'Yes, there is a small garden' → IS THERE A GARDEN?
  'How about Saturday afternoon?' → WHEN CAN I SEE IT?
  ⚠ Oltita savolning hammasi ro'yxatda berilgan — faqat joyini topish kerak.

⚠ 14-MAShQ — JADVALDAN XATGA: to'rt bo'shliqning hammasi jadvaldagi ma'lumotdan yoziladi. Jadval qanday tartibda bo'lsa, xat ham shunday boradi: TYPE+WHERE → SIZE+INSIDE → OUTSIDE → FEELINGS.
  ⚠ Jadvaldagi 'home is where the heart is' — maqol, xatning oxirida ishlatiladi. Ma'nosi: 'uy — yurak qayerda bo'lsa, o'sha yer'.

⚠ 13-MAShQ MATNIDAGI MAQOL: 'There is no place like home' = 'uydan yaxshi joy yo'q'. O'zbekcha muqobili: 'O'z uying — o'lan to'shaging'.

sections.title: Asking for Information about a House

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue and fill in the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni o'qing va savollarni joyiga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOLLAR RO'YXATI (oltitasi ham ishlatiladi):
  How many rooms has it got?  — Nechta xonasi bor?
  Where is it?                — U qayerda?
  When can I see it?          — Uni qachon ko'rsam bo'ladi?
  What's it like?             — U qanaqa?
  Is there a garden?          — Bog'i bormi?
  How much is it?             — Narxi qancha?

HAR BIR SAVOLNI JAVOBIDAN TOPING:
  javob joy haqida bo'lsa   → Where is it?
  javob tavsif bo'lsa       → What's it like?
  javob narx bo'lsa         → How much is it?
  javob xonalar ro'yxati    → How many rooms has it got?
  javob 'Yes, there is...'  → Is there a garden?
  javob kun/vaqt bo'lsa     → When can I see it?

MUHIM IBORA — 'What's it like?'
Bu 'U nimani yoqtiradi?' EMAS! 'like' bu yerda 'kabi' ma'nosida:
  What's it like? = U qanaqa? Uni tasvirlab bering.
Javobi sifat bilan beriladi: 'It's a big house.'

TELEFONDA:
  Is that Ms Powers?  — Bu Powers xonimmi?
  Who's speaking?     — Kim gapiryapti?
  Ms — turmush qurgan yoki qurmaganini bildirmaydigan murojaat
  (Mrs — turmush qurgan, Miss — qurmagan)

lines.textEn: I'm Tony Black. I want to rent your house.
lines.uz: Men Toni Blekman. Uyingizni ijaraga olmoqchiman.

lines.hintUz: Keyingi javob — shaharning qaysi tomonida ekani
lines.whyUz: Javob 'It's on the other side of town, in Silverdale Drive' — joy. Demak savol joy haqida.

lines.textEn: It's on the other side of town, in Silverdale Drive.
lines.uz: U shaharning narigi tomonida, Silverdeyl yo'lida.

lines.hintUz: Keyingi javob — uyning TAVSIFI (katta, qimmat emas)
lines.whyUz: Javob 'It's a big house, actually and it's not very expensive' — tavsif. 'What's it like?' = U qanaqa?

lines.textEn: It's a big house, actually and it's not very expensive.
lines.uz: Aslida u katta uy va unchalik qimmat emas.

lines.whyUz: Javob 'It's only £500 per month' — narx. Narx uchun 'How much'.

lines.answer: How many rooms has it got?
lines.whyUz: Javob xonalar ro'yxati — demak savol xonalar SONI haqida. Sanaladigan narsa uchun 'How many'.

lines.textEn: There are two bedrooms, a bathroom, a living-room, a dining-room, a kitchen and a garage.
lines.uz: Ikkita yotoqxona, hammom, mehmonxona, ovqatlanish xonasi, oshxona va garaj bor.

lines.hintUz: Keyingi javob 'Yes, there is...' bilan boshlanadi
lines.whyUz: Javob 'Yes, there is a small garden...' — bu HA/YO'Q savoliga javob. Demak savol 'Is there ...?' shaklida.

lines.textEn: Yes, there is a small garden at the front of the house and a larger garden at the back. It's lovely.
lines.uz: Ha, uyning oldida kichik bog', orqasida esa kattaroq bog' bor. U go'zal.

lines.whyUz: Javob 'How about Saturday afternoon?' — kun. Vaqt uchun 'When'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text and make notes under these headings, then use your notes to talk about Steve's house.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni o'qing. Har bir gapning tarjimasi va izohi berilgan.
exercises.explanationUz:
Sarlavhalar: TYPE OF PLACE - WHERE - SIZE - INSIDE THE HOUSE -
OUTSIDE THE HOUSE - FEELINGS

Bu — uy haqida gapirishning STANDART tartibi. Coursebook 19 va
23-betlarda ham xuddi shu sarlavhalar ishlatilgan.

Avval matnni to'liq o'qing, keyin qayd olish mashqiga o'ting.

sentences.en: My family and I live in a pretty house near the centre of Brighton.
sentences.uz: Oilam va men Brayton markaziga yaqin chiroyli uyda yashaymiz.
sentences.noteUz: 'My family and I' — inglizchada 'I' OXIRIDA turadi (I and my family EMAS). Bu muloyimlik qoidasi.

sentences.en: Brighton is a lovely city on the south coast of England.
sentences.uz: Brayton — Angliyaning janubiy qirg'og'idagi go'zal shahar.

sentences.en: My house is quite big and it is in a very nice area.
sentences.uz: Uyim ancha katta va juda yaxshi hududda.
sentences.noteUz: 'area' bilan IN. quite = ancha, very = juda.

sentences.en: There are seven rooms in it.
Upstairs, there are two bedrooms and a bathroom.
sentences.uz: Tepa qavatda ikkita yotoqxona va hammom bor.
sentences.noteUz: 'There ARE' — chunki birinchi ot ko'plik (two bedrooms).

sentences.en: My bedroom is quite big and it has got a comfortable single bed and lots of posters on the walls.
sentences.uz: Yotoqxonam ancha katta, unda qulay bir kishilik karavot va devorlarda ko'p plakatlar bor.
sentences.noteUz: 'lots of' = ko'p (a lot of bilan bir xil). Devor uchun ON.

sentences.en: Downstairs, there is a big kitchen, a spacious living-room, a study and a small bathroom.
sentences.uz: Past qavatda katta oshxona, keng mehmonxona, ish xonasi va kichik hammom bor.
sentences.noteUz: 'There IS' — birinchi ot birlik (a big kitchen). Ingliz tilida fe'l BIRINCHI otga qarab tanlanadi.

sentences.en: My favourite room is the study because there is a big bookcase with lots of books there.
sentences.uz: Eng yoqtirgan xonam — ish xonasi, chunki u yerda ko'p kitobli katta javon bor.
sentences.noteUz: 'because' — sabab. Fikrni asoslash uchun ishlatiladi — insho va gapirishda juda muhim.

sentences.en: Outside our house, there is a garage for my parents' car and a huge garden with lots of trees and flowers.
sentences.uz: Uyimiz tashqarisida ota-onamning mashinasi uchun garaj va ko'p daraxt-gulli ulkan bog' bor.
sentences.noteUz: 'my parents' car' — apostrof 's' dan KEYIN, chunki 'parents' ko'plik.

sentences.en: I love my house because it makes me feel safe and relaxed.
sentences.uz: Uyimni yaxshi ko'raman, chunki u meni xavfsiz va tinch his qildiradi.
sentences.noteUz: 'makes me feel' — 'meni ... his qildiradi'. safe = xavfsiz, relaxed = tinch, xotirjam.

sentences.en: After all, there is no place like home.

exercises.instructionEn: Make notes under these headings, then use your notes to talk about Steve's house.
exercises.instructionUz: Sarlavhalar bo'yicha qayd yozing, so'ng qaydlaringiz bilan Stivning uyi haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
QAYD OLISH — matndan faqat KERAKLI ma'lumotni ajratib olish.

Har bir sarlavha uchun matndan javob toping:
  TYPE OF PLACE — qanday uy?
  WHERE — qayerda?
  SIZE — qanchalik katta?
  INSIDE — ichkarida nima bor?
  OUTSIDE — tashqarida nima bor?
  FEELINGS — u qanday his qiladi?

Quyida har bir sarlavha uchun to'liq javob berilgan.
Avval o'zingiz yozib ko'ring, keyin solishtiring.

structure.modelEn: It is near the centre of Brighton, a lovely city on the south coast of England, in a very nice area.
structure.noteUz: Uch bosqich: shahar qismi → shahar → mamlakat.

structure.modelEn: It is quite big — there are seven rooms in it.
Upstairs, there are two bedrooms and a bathroom.
His bedroom is quite big and it has got a comfortable single bed and lots of posters on the walls.
Downstairs, there is a big kitchen, a spacious living-room, a study and a small bathroom.
His favourite room is the study because there is a big bookcase with lots of books there.
Outside the house, there is a garage for his parents' car and a huge garden with lots of trees and flowers.
He loves his house because it makes him feel safe and relaxed.
structure.noteUz: DIQQAT: matnda 'I love MY house... makes ME feel'. Boshqa odam haqida gapirganda 'HE loves HIS house... makes HIM feel' bo'ladi.

structure.modelEn: After all, there is no place like home.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the information in the table below to complete Terry's letter to his friend, Brian.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvaldagi ma'lumotni o'qing — xatni shu asosda to'ldirasiz.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL — xat yozish uchun XOM MA'LUMOT. Unda to'liq gap yo'q,
faqat kalit so'zlar bor. Sizning ishingiz — ularni TO'LIQ GAPGA aylantirish.

sentences.en: WHERE: in the centre of Banbury

sentences.noteUz: Kvartira uchun katta (uy bilan solishtirganda kichik).

sentences.en: INSIDE THE FLAT: five rooms — two small bedrooms (each with wardrobe & double bed)
sentences.uz: Ichkarisi: beshta xona — ikkita kichik yotoqxona (har birida shkaf va ikki kishilik karavot)
sentences.noteUz: '&' — 'and' belgisi, faqat qayd va jadvalda ishlatiladi.

sentences.uz: bitta kichik hammom (dush, qo'l yuvgich, hojatxona)

sentences.en: one small kitchen; one spacious living-room (sofa, two armchairs, TV, big fireplace)
sentences.uz: bitta kichik oshxona; bitta keng mehmonxona (divan, ikkita kreslo, televizor, katta kamin)

sentences.en: OUTSIDE THE FLAT: small balcony (lots of flowers), garage
FEELINGS: a great flat — small but comfortable; home is where the heart is
sentences.uz: His-tuyg'ular: ajoyib kvartira — kichik, lekin qulay; uy — qalb qayerda bo'lsa, o'sha yer

exercises.instructionEn: Use the information in the table below to complete Terry's letter to his friend, Brian.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvaldan foydalanib, Terrining do'sti Brianga yozgan xatini to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
XATNING BERILGAN QISMLARI:

  Dear Brian,
  At last, Rachel and I are in our new home and we're very happy with it.
  It's a big ____________
  There are five ____________
  Our flat has also got ____________
  It's a great ____________
  Rachel and I are having a house-warming party next weekend.
  Lots of people are coming, so please try and come too.
  Hope to see you soon.
  Best wishes,
  Terry

TO'RTTA BO'SHLIQ — har biri jadvalning bitta qatoriga to'g'ri keladi:
  'It's a big ...'         → TYPE OF PLACE + WHERE
  'There are five ...'     → INSIDE THE FLAT
  'Our flat has also got ...' → OUTSIDE THE FLAT
  'It's a great ...'       → FEELINGS

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  At last          — nihoyat
  house-warming party — yangi uyga ko'chganda beriladigan ziyofat
  next weekend     — kelasi dam olish kunlari
  try and come     — kelishga harakat qiling
  Best wishes      — do'stona xat oxiri ('Love' dan rasmiyroq)

structure.modelEn: At last, Rachel and I are in our new home and we're very happy with it.
It's a big flat in the centre of Banbury.
structure.noteUz: Jadvaldan: TYPE OF PLACE = flat, WHERE = in the centre of Banbury, SIZE = big.

structure.modelEn: There are five rooms — two small bedrooms, each with a wardrobe and a double bed, one small bathroom with a shower, a washbasin and a toilet, one small kitchen and one spacious living-room with a sofa, two armchairs, a TV and a big fireplace.
structure.noteUz: Jadvaldagi '&' o'rniga 'and' yoziladi. Qavslar o'rniga 'with' ishlatiladi.

structure.modelEn: Our flat has also got a small balcony with lots of flowers and a garage.
It's a great flat — it's small but comfortable. After all, home is where the heart is.
structure.noteUz: Jadvaldan: FEELINGS. Maqol bilan tugatish — chiroyli yakun.

structure.modelEn: Rachel and I are having a house-warming party next weekend.
Lots of people are coming, so please try and come too. Hope to see you soon.

wordFormation.introUz: Workbook 15-bet — so'roq so'zlari, egalik va his-tuyg'u sifatlari.

groups.explanationUz: Har bir so'roq so'zi o'z javob turiga ega. Javobni bilsangiz, savolni topasiz.

items.derived: How many rooms has it got?

groups.explanationUz: Apostrof 's' dan oldinmi yoki keyinmi — ot birlikmi-ko'plikmi ekaniga bog'liq.
Odam qanday his qilishini bildiruvchi sifatlar ko'pincha -ed bilan tugaydi.

groups.ruleUz: Xat oxiridagi iboralar — qay biri qachon

sentencePatterns.introUz: Workbook 15-betdagi qoliplar — uy haqida so'rash va yozish.

patterns.formula: What's it like? — It's a + sifat + ot.
patterns.exampleEn: What's it like? — It's a big house and it's not very expensive.
patterns.exampleUz: U qanaqa? — U katta uy va unchalik qimmat emas.
patterns.explanationUz: Tavsif so'rash. 'like' bu yerda 'kabi' ma'nosida — 'nimaga o'xshaydi?'

patterns.formula: How much is it? — It's only £... per month.
patterns.exampleEn: How much is it? — It's only £500 per month.
patterns.explanationUz: Pul sanalmaydi, shuning uchun 'How much'. 'only' narxni arzon ko'rsatadi.

patterns.formula: There is/are ... AT THE FRONT / AT THE BACK of the house.
patterns.exampleEn: There is a small garden at the front of the house and a larger garden at the back.
patterns.exampleUz: Uyning oldida kichik bog', orqasida esa kattaroq bog' bor.
patterns.explanationUz:
'at the front of' — old tomonida, 'at the back' — orqa tomonida.
'larger' — 'large' ning qiyosiy shakli (kattaroq).

patterns.exampleEn: It makes me feel safe and relaxed.
patterns.exampleUz: U meni xavfsiz va xotirjam his qildiradi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'make somebody feel ...' — 'kimnidir ... his qildirmoq'.
'feel' dan keyin TO ishlatilmaydi: makes me FEEL (to feel EMAS).

patterns.exampleEn: My favourite room is the study because there is a big bookcase there.
patterns.exampleUz: Eng yoqtirgan xonam — ish xonasi, chunki u yerda katta kitob javoni bor.
patterns.explanationUz:
'because' — fikrni asoslash. Insho va gapirishda baho oshiradi:
faqat 'I like it' emas, NEGA yoqtirishingizni ayting.

patterns.exampleEn: At last, Rachel and I are in our new home. After all, home is where the heart is.
patterns.exampleUz: Nihoyat, Reychel va men yangi uyimizdamiz. Axir, uy — qalb qayerda bo'lsa, o'sha yer.
patterns.explanationUz:
'At last' — uzoq kutishdan keyin (nihoyat).
'After all' — xulosa qilganda (axir, oxir-oqibat).
Ikkalasidan keyin ham VERGUL qo'yiladi.
